title: 04_severe_mechanism_co_svr
interpretation: Over 72 h both arms cross the MAP<65 shock threshold (extraction at 54.1 h to MAP 58, engine at 69.3 h to MAP 64) by different routes: the engine declines via cardiac-output failure with near-constant SVR (hypodynamic/low-output), while the extraction holds output and swings SVR — vasoconstriction then sympathetic-fatigue vasodilation (hyperdynamic/warm), reaching shock ~15 h earlier. The extraction's single AIR→sympathetic arc overshoots the vasomotor response the engine's full cardiovascular control keeps muted.
